newsAll.head: Jonah Coleman: Lands on injured reserve
newsAll.body: Coleman (ankle) is being placed on injured reserve Saturday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

newsAll.head: Dallas Goedert: Won't play Monday
newsAll.body: Goedert (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bears.

newsAll.head: DeVonta Smith: Good to go against Chicago
newsAll.body: Smith (hamstring) does not carry an injury designation into Monday's game against the Bears.

newsAll.head: Tyson Bagent: Listed as questionable Monday
newsAll.body: Bagent (concussion) was a full participant in Saturday's practice but is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Eagles.

newsAll.head: Caleb Williams: Ruled out for Monday
newsAll.body: Williams (hamstring) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Eagles.
